name: Mitten Extracts 510 Cartridge | Passion Orange Guava
description: Bright, bold, and tropically vibrant, Passion Orange Guava blends citrus spark with lush island sweetness. The orange hits first with a zesty pop, followed by the tart passion fruit and smooth guava that rounds everything out. Expect a lively, energizing flavor that feels like a mini vacation in every hit.
